descriptions.w3d_f11a_apply_team_name_80299520: For an empty by-value shared name, write zero to User.Skill. Otherwise compute the team-property comparison result, require exact result1 for the initial flag, clear that flag when Q.Perm reads1, and call the observed team flag helper with a retained by-value copy of the name.
